Q00693_DefeatingDragonkinRemnants/32527-.text: Officer Edric: Hail! I am Officer Edric, who manages the remnant of the Mounted Troop here. We caught some of the Mounted Troop's lesser minions when the Seed of Destruction became temporarily stable . Do you have time for a chat?

Officer Edric: The Seed of Destruction is on the rise. Orders have come down to withdraw. We must flee now and hope for the best... Perhaps fortune will allow us to wage this battle some other time. Right now, our focus just needs to be on survival.

Officer Edric: When I was a soldier, I fought, armed only with patriotism and loyalty. And I survived, as you can see. But all I got for my efforts were these menial chores and this lowly rank of "Officer." Ha! How I long for the days when I saw my enemy face to face! But I am still a soldier, and …
